name: The Times
description: Follow The Times, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: In Small Iranian Town, a U.S. Attack Turns a Wedding Into a Tragedy
changes.summary: The bomb that hit the residential area was American, according to a weapons expert and a visual analysis by The Times. It killed five people and wounded 67 others, the Iranian authorities said.

changes.title: Discovered by Atlas
changes.summary: The Times first entered the public knowledge record with source-backed evidence.

changes.title: U.S. Withdraws Subpoenas Issued to New York Times Journalists
changes.summary: A federal judge raised questions about the government’s handling of the subpoenas, which The Times called an attempt to intimidate the free press.

changes.title: U.S. to Withdraw Subpoenas Issued to New York Times Journalists

changes.title: A Russian Spy, Suddenly Cast Into the Spotlight, Flees Japan
changes.summary: The military intelligence officer left the country after The Times reported that he was using the Aeroflot airline office in Tokyo to conduct espionage.
